texts.orig: There are at least two benefits of utilizing SDN control in cluster-level routing. Firstly; compared with SDN management for every node in WSN, CluFlow trades granularity of SDN control for less communication load. Only cluster border nodes communicate with the SDN controller. The number of decreases Secondly; cluster-level routing and local routing are decoupled. The nodes inside the clusters use only distributed local routing and do not need to request flow table entries from the SDN controller. The   communication   delay   caused by   requesting flow table entries therefore decreases.
